name: Alistair Drew
source: The most promising athlete of the school, Alistair is kind, down-to-earth and very hardworking. He specializes in martial arts in general, but his favorite sport is boxing, in which he dreams of making a career out of and competing in the Olympic Games one day. Unlike most of his classmates, Alistair comes from a middle-class family. Despite the difference in social classes, he and Tadashi have been best friends for a long time.
